title: The Full Scene
description: Raymarch a melted blob on a floor with soft shadows, ambient occlusion and fog, lit by a light that circles it. The canvas runs from -1 to 1 (aspect-corrected, centred). Camera: ro = (0, 3.5, 4.5), looking at (0, 0.3, 0). Use ww = normalize(target - ro), uu = normalize(cross(ww, vec3(0, 1, 0))), vv = cross(uu, ww), and rd = normalize(uv.x * uu + uv.y * vv + 2.0 * ww). March up to 64 steps with t += d, hit when d < 0.001, give up when t > 40. The blob joins sphere A (centre (-0.45, 0.55, 0), radius 0.55) and sphere B (centre (0.50, 0.45, 0.25), radius 0.45) with smin(a, b, 0.5), where smin uses h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0) / k and returns min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25. The scene is the closer of the blob and the floor, whose distance is p.y. Take the normal from central differences with eps 0.001. The light direction is l = normalize(vec3(1.5 * cos(a), 2.0, 1.5 * sin(a))) with a = 6.28318 * u_time / 16.0, one orbit every 16 seconds; diffuse = max(dot(n, l), 0.0). Soft shadow: start at p + n * 0.01 with res = 1.0 and t = 0.02, and loop up to 32 times: h = the scene distance at start + l * t, res = min(res, 3.0 * h / t), t += clamp(h, 0.02, 0.4), stop if res < 0.001 or t > 10; the shadow is clamp(res, 0.0, 1.0). Occlusion: occ = 0.0 and w = 1.0, then for i = 0 to 4, h = 0.04 + 0.1 * i, occ += (h - scene(p + n * h)) * w, w *= 0.7; ao = clamp(1.0 - 2.5 * occ, 0.0, 1.0). With sky = 0.5 + 0.5 * n.y, the colour is albedo * (0.25 * sky * ao + 0.75 * diffuse * shadow). The albedo is mint (0.30, 0.75, 0.55) where the blob is closer than 0.002, otherwise warm white (0.92, 0.88, 0.80). Then fog it: mix(colour, fog, 1.0 - exp(-0.06 * t)) with fog (0.62, 0.70, 0.80), where t is the hit distance. A miss is the fog colour.
